prose.ld_note: Three flyer posts are live (24, 18 and 17 Nov) and all four flyer images print prices valid through Sat 28 Nov, so these hold for a Tuesday or Wednesday shop: the two page Thanksgiving flyer (17 and 24 Nov) with top sirloin steaks $16.99/lb, top sirloin roasts $15.99/lb, frozen lamb legs $7.29/lb, fresh red snapper fillets $17.99/lb, salmon $24.99/lb, Seara halal whole chickens 1300 g $5.40, Cornish hens $7.20, Campbell's cream of mushroom soup $1.99, Land O Lakes butter $8.45 a pound and Tree Ripe orange juice 52 oz $7.65; the new Great Deals on Great Brands page (24 Nov) with Tyson bone-in thighs 5 lb $18.45, Kerrygold 454 g $9.20, Pillsbury dough, Betty Crocker mixes, Crisco oil $10.19, Scott 4 roll $5.85 and Coke 6 packs; the Autumn Savings page (17 Nov) with Spice Islands spices, coffee, cereal, drinks, cleaning, Vicks and pet lines; and the Lindo's Next Level bulk page (18 Nov). 201 lines in all. The flyers were machine read on the laptop on Tuesday morning (199 lines from EasyOCR and Tesseract, with 120 flagged doubtful and the Thanksgiving spread counted twice) and then every image was re-read by hand the same morning because the OCR list mixed product names and carried impossible prices (a $182.75 bottle, $97.20 shredded cheese); 133 of the hand read prices matched an OCR line, the other 68 were corrected or added. The 10 Nov Kraft Heinz and LNL pages have dropped off the Lindo's site, so Anchor butter, Palmolive 20 oz, Viva towels and the bulk pancake mix are no longer listed. Deli cheese and chicken breast lines marked Devonshire only are at Lindo's Market, not Family Foods. 5% off on Tuesdays and Wednesdays through 2026 (excludes alcohol, cigarettes, pharmacy, magazines and general merchandise).
prose.sm_note: The flyer in the table is the Wed 18 to Sun 22 Nov one (35 lines): sirloin steak $15.99/lb, stir fry beef strips $15.49/lb, sirloin roast $16.49/lb, English ham $18.99/lb, Faroe Island salmon $24.99/lb, green cabbage $1.49/lb, broccoli $3.69/lb, Gala apples $8.29 a 3 lb bag, Tree Ripe orange juice 59 oz $6.99, Jif 16 oz $4.99, Barritts 4 packs $5.49 and Waitrose cat food 12 pouches $11.99. It ended on Sunday and the Wed 25 to Sun 29 Nov flyer had not been posted by Tuesday morning, on the website or on Facebook (checked in the browser pane at 7am; the newest posts are the 2026 holiday dessert menu and a Waitrose Blueprint Romanian pinot noir plug), so for a Wednesday shop treat these as last week's guide and check supermart.bm or the Front Street door on the way in; the collector will pick the new flyer up and the OCR will read it the morning after it appears. This flyer was transcribed by hand on 17 Nov and machine read again on the laptop on 24 Nov (33 lines, 30 flagged doubtful): every OCR price agreed with the hand list except Jacob's cream crackers ($4.79, not $4.19) and Barritts tonic water ($5.49, not $5.73), so the hand list stands. Thanksgiving turkey pre-orders (from $7.49/lb) are being picked up 24 to 26 Nov. Supermart specials run Wednesday to Sunday; Waitrose range is exclusive to Supermart.
prose.staples_overall: Overall: MarketPlace is cheapest on 18 of the 26 staple rows on Tuesday's read, with eggs at $2.89 a dozen, store family pack thighs $3.25/lb, Tyson breast $4.99/lb, family pack ground beef $5.49/lb (a 90 day low, down from $5.79), Kerrygold 200 g $4.79, Tide 25 oz $7.79 and Charmin 4 mega rolls $9.99, and 5% off on top on Tuesday and Wednesday. Pronto wins six rows (Kraft cheddar block $5.49, Pepperidge Farm bread $8.29, Cheerios $8.89, Dawn $4.49, the only Tropicana 46 oz at $8.59 and a Corn Flakes 12 oz listing at $5.92 that still looks like a unit price) and Miles two (Jif $4.95 and Dave's Killer Powerseed $8.75); Miles returned prices on only 16 rows, so several of its cells are blank rather than beaten. Pronto's Charmin 6 mega rolls is back to $13.09, its 90 day low. Against the flyers, Lindo's Chobani cups at $2.29 (to 28 Nov) beat MarketPlace's $2.84 and Lindo's Land O Lakes at $8.45 a pound beats MarketPlace's Kerrygold per gram; Supermart's Tree Ripe 59 oz $6.99 was the best orange juice but that flyer ended Sunday.

prose.rshops_sub: Newest post from each shop in the weekly sweep, grouped by category. Each shop's line ends with its tier: weekly (web store or a post in the last 30 days), monthly (checked on the first run of each month, including shops not yet found) or parked (no post in over a year, checked in January, April, July and October). This was a weekly sweep: the laptop collector read 63 weekly tier pages signed out on Mon 23 Nov (grocery, farms, 26 retail shops and 20 eats pages) and Claude re-read 9 pages signed in on Tue 24 Nov; the collector also re-read the Red Laser, Gosling's, Masters, Phoenix, P-Tech and Annex Toys sites on Tuesday morning with no new uploads. Black Friday week is the story: Sunglass and Watch Shop (up to 70% off to Sat 28 Nov), Astwood Dickinson (up to 75% off to Sat 28 Nov), Flatts Menswear (storewide sale Thu 26 to Sat 28 Nov) and Crisson's Pandora week join the Waterfront Man Butterfield offer and Masters' Christmas draw above. Palm Lane turned up as a Facebook page through a Gibbons share on 20 Nov (holiday home new arrivals), so it is no longer "not found". Ten weekly shops whose page address was never recorded could not be read (Gorham's, Baptiste, Rowe Spurling Paint, Sportseller, Bermuda Bookstore, A.S. Cooper, Makin' Waves, TABS, Aberfeldy and Burrows Lightbourn) and carry their earlier note. Alexandra Mosher (26 Oct) has now gone 30 days without a post and moves to the monthly tier; Urban Cottage and Flying Colours (both 4 Nov) follow on 4 Dec if nothing appears. The monthly tier shops and the 19 not yet found are next checked on Tue 1 Dec; parked shops in January.
prose.eats_sub: Quick food across the island: fast food, chicken and jerk, pizza, sushi, Indian, Chinese and local takeout, with hours, phone, delivery and menu links. Deals and notices at the top come from each place's newest public Facebook post, website specials page and Sargasso Sea listing: the collector read 20 eats pages signed out on Mon 23 Nov, Claude re-read Misaki, Kebobs and the four unreadable pages signed in on Tue 24 Nov, and the Speciality Inn and La Trattoria specials pages were fetched the same morning. Pizza House, Rustico, Coconut Rock and Henry VIII all return "content isn't available" on Facebook even signed in, so their addresses on file are dead. New this week: Misaki's posted daily specials with weekend bowls at $25 to $28 and a lobster roll at $29, Four Star's Indian pizza of the month to 30 Nov, and La Trattoria's Thanksgiving buffet on Thu 26 Nov; L'Oriental's Japan buffet nights end tonight. Hours are from listings and can drift, so a call before a long ride is worth it.
